capabilities.reason: Stock default provider in exact OpenSSL build; third-party providers not loaded
Stock default provider in exact OpenSSL build; third-party providers not loaded

limits: Within-provider observations only; no cross-provider ranking.
Peak RSS is a noisy process measure; small differences do not resolve an operation-level byte delta.
Painted-stack extent is a diagnostic lower bound on touched depth, includes startup/exit, and is not a formal maximum stack-use proof. No-op floor is reported, not subtracted.
Metrics not collected in a mode are omitted or null; raw zero placeholders are not zero-resource claims.
Full-operation allocation counters cover configured OpenSSL/OQS allocator entry points, not all possible system mmap/allocator internals.
